input: Scheduled ventures brief: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (full text in prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md)
task: Deepen (flagship 2) ai-bookkeeper: BUILDABLE item 'ONNX Runtime Web for the page' - RapidOCR in the browser

errors.what: tesseract run with xargs -P 4 and default OpenMP threads ran ~30x slow (16 threads on 4 cores)
first plain-tesseract SRD baseline (137/196) skipped the CLI's shaded-photo passes
errors.fix: re-read with eval/srd-cli.mjs, which matches the documented 156

doc_friction.issue: ai-bookkeeper's BUILDABLE item 1 (parser misses on CORD train shards 1-3) needs CORD photos from huggingface.co, which this session's proxy refused (403); the row names no hosts: list, so allocate.py could not warn
cloud-session notes do not mention OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1 when running tesseract in parallel; default OpenMP threading made a 200-photo read take tens of minutes

deviations.why: allocate named chant-forge (row 7); two sessions in two days left it for its remaining items being fine singing/OMR tweaks, and the brief asks for revenue-relevant depth. Took row 1 ai-bookkeeper's BUILDABLE 'ONNX Runtime Web for the page' (its other item needs huggingface, blocked); no open ai-bookkeeper PR.
deviations.did: ported RapidOCR to the browser and wired it into the receipts page
deviations.result: page photo totals 155 to 184 of 196 on SRD, taxes 135 to 166 of 185

goal: flagship depth: a stronger receipt-photo reader on the free page, no per-user cost
notes: rapidocr-web.mjs ports rapidocr-onnxruntime 1.4.4 (config defaults) to JS over ONNX Runtime Web; models from npm @gutenye/ocr-models@1.4.2 (outputs equal to the wheel's: max diff 0.0 on random inputs). Exactness fixes: Clipper round-join unclip (39/39 boxes identical on photo 1002) and OpenCV fixed-point INTER_LINEAR. Headless Chromium on 200 SRD photos: rows identical to Python on 170/199, 98.5% of lines; page settled totals tesseract four 155/196 -> RapidOCR + four 184/196; tax 135 -> 166 of 185. 3.8 s/photo single-thread WASM under contention; blocks the main thread (next: Web Worker). CORD not re-read (huggingface 403). eval/photo-ocr-browser.mjs end to end passes (13 checks). Verification: ai-bookkeeper suite 3,319 tests pass (run_venture_tests.py, 260 s); venture-preflight clean; post front matter/links/similarity clean; validate.py clean.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: porting a CV/OCR inference pipeline to JS with bit-level parity checks, browser integration and a 200-photo evaluation: about two days for a senior engineer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
